rules.why: No plan is approved in this session: present one with run('plan', 'plan_present'), ask the user with the form, then edit.
The approved plan does not name this file: present a new revision that names it and ask the user again.
The state of the harness (its ledger, its maint grant) is written by the harness only, never by an edit.

The harness's data (state/) is never opened by the shell, Read, Grep or Glob: read the ledger with run('ledger', 'db_query', {sql}), one read-only SELECT; run('maint', 'status') says whether the guards are off.
Only the user answers a form: call AskUserQuestion with the questions alone.
A question of a form may not hold '"="': ask the questions as the harness gave them.
The harness cannot read this command whole, so it asks you before it runs; allow it only if the agent's words match the command
The harness cannot read this command whole, so it asks the user before it runs: write in the tool's description, in plain words, what the command does and what it changes, then run it again.
The turn does not end yet: code files of the plan changed since the last green verify. Run python3 -m entry.cli verify (bare, from .claude/) and fix what is red.
A rule is never a file in .claude/rules/: write it as a skill in harness/mcp/skill_docs/<name>/SKILL.md, read through find and guide.
A point to keep is never a memory file: keep it as a note in SQL (the notes block).
The behaviour registry is written by its doors only: python3 -m entry.cli add test, or behaviors add.
Only Claude Code runs the harness's session start, when a session begins. In a session, a newer harness comes with live update and the user's Allow: python3 <core>/anchor.py cli live update.

What decides which code a session runs (anchor.py, .claude/entry/boot.py, .claude/settings.json, .mcp.json) is never written in a session: the user changes it outside one; harness code reaches sessions through live publish.
The session wants to delete a file on Google Drive. The ledger store only adds files and never deletes them; allow it only if you really want this file deleted
The session wants to rename or move a file on Google Drive. Files in the ledger store keep their name and place; allow it only if you really want this file changed

The turn does not end yet: work of this session is in no copy of the store. run('ledger', 'export', {reason: 'turn-end'}), then upload the copy with the Google Drive tool as the answer says (guide('store', 'skills')). With no Google Drive tool in this session, tell the user the copy was not uploaded; the turn then ends.

A child session never asks the user: nobody is at its keyboard. Ask the orchestrator with run('orchestra', 'question', {question}) and send it with send_message, or name it under notChecked in the handback.
A child never merges, pulls or rebases: the orchestrator merges its branch on accept. Hand back instead; if the base moved, ask the orchestrator.
A child pushes only its own branch, with run('orchestra', 'push').

Nobody is at this child session's keyboard, so the harness does not ask: this step is refused. Do not retry it in another shape. Go on with what you can, and name this step under notChecked in your handback (or ask the orchestrator with run('orchestra', 'question')).
